segments.an4.216:1.1: … Pe … micchāājīvo hoti, micchāvāyāmo hoti, micchāsati hoti, micchāsamādhi hoti … pe … sammāājīvo hoti, sammāvāyāmo hoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti.

lines: 214-217. Catutthaṃ catunnaṃ kammakilesānaṃ tappaṭipakkhassa ca vasena vuttaṃ, pañcamaṃ sukkapakkhānaṃ ādito catunnaṃ micchattānaṃ vasena, chaṭṭhaṃ avasesānaṃ catunnaṃ, sattamaṃ anariyavohāraariyavohārānaṃ.
Tathā aṭṭhamanavamadasamāni sappaṭipakkhānaṃ assaddhammānaṃ vasena vuttāni.
Navasu suttesu kiñcāpi “sagge”ti vuttaṃ, tayo pana maggā tīṇi ca phalāni labbhantiyevāti.
